senses.sense_definition: The process by which organic matter is replaced by minerals and turns into stone.

examples.text: The <w>petrification</w> of the ancient forest took millions of years to complete.
Scientists studied the <w>petrification</w> process to understand how these fossils were formed.

senses.sense_definition: A state of being frozen or paralyzed by extreme fear.

examples.text: She stood in total <w>petrification</w> as the loud noise echoed through the dark room.
The sudden sight of the predator caused a moment of absolute <w>petrification</w> for the small animal.

senses.sense_definition: A state of being emotionally hardened or insensitive.

examples.text: His <w>petrification</w> of heart made it impossible for him to show any sympathy.
Years of cruelty led to a complete <w>petrification</w> of his moral conscience.

traits.comment: Used in a figurative or literary sense.
